Batalla del Somme. Después de dos meses: Battle of the Somme. After two months of slaughter, the British debut a secret weapon the soldiers call "tanks" (the code name was "water tanks"). There are 49 Mark Is; many break down before arriving. The Germans had never seen anything like it.
Cruzá la tierra de nadie con tu Mark I,: Cross no man's land in your Mark I, roll over the trenches and take the ruins of Flers, Delville Wood and the farm. The German field guns are your worst enemy: protect your sides.
Tu tanque no tiene torre: los cañones es: Your tank has no turret: the guns are in the side sponsons. To fire forward, turn the hull a little. If the gearsmen die, the tank turns very slowly.
Ofensiva Nivelle, en el Chemin des Dames: The Nivelle Offensive, on the Chemin des Dames. The first French tank attack: 128 Schneider CA1s. The German artillery sees them coming from the heights and the tanks, with fuel along their sides, catch fire easily.
Avanzá con los Schneider, abrí paso a la: Advance with the Schneiders, clear the way for the infantry and take the three positions. Don't stand still under the guns' fire.
El 75 mm del Schneider es corto y solo a: The Schneider's 75 mm is short and only aims forward to the right: line the hull up with the target. It fires HE: good against guns, trenches and infantry.
Casi 400 tanques Mark IV atacan juntos l: Almost 400 Mark IV tanks attack the Hindenburg Line together, with no preliminary bombardment so as not to give warning. They go through the wire as if it were grass. But on Flesquières ridge the German batteries are waiting, and they destroy dozens of tanks.
Rompé la Línea Hindenburg: tomá el Bosqu: Break the Hindenburg Line: take Orival Wood, the village of Flesquières and Premy Farm. Find and destroy the guns on the ridge before they find you.
Las trincheras alemanas son anchísimas:: The German trenches are very wide: the Mark IV crosses them, short tanks sink in a bit. The females carry machine guns to clear trenches.
Ofensiva de primavera alemana. Entre la: The German Spring Offensive. Out of the fog and gas come three A7Vs. A male Mark IV and two females move to meet them: it's the first tank-versus-tank battle in history. The females, with no cannon, have to withdraw.
Con tu Mark IV macho, enfrentá a los A7V: With your male Mark IV, take on the A7Vs and retake the town, the wood and the hamlet of Cachy. The Whippets will help you in the counterattack.
El A7V tiene 30 mm al frente, más de lo: The A7V has 30 mm at the front, more than your 6-pounder penetrates at range. Get close and hit its side (20 mm) or its gun. Shots that don't penetrate can still kill crew inside.
El mismo día, del otro lado. Los A7V \"N: The same day, from the other side. The A7Vs "Nixe", "Siegfried" and "Schnuck" lead the attack with the storm troops. There are few of them (Germany built only 20) and each carries 18 men inside.
Llevá tu A7V hasta Villers-Bretonneux y: Take your A7V to Villers-Bretonneux and hold the town, the wood and Cachy against the British Mark IVs and Whippets.
El A7V es lento y se encaja en las trinc: The A7V is slow and gets stuck in wide trenches, but its front holds. Always show your front to the enemy. If the gunner dies, another crewman takes his place.
La primera gran ofensiva del ejército es: The US Army's first major offensive in France. The Tank Corps' Renault FTs advance with the infantry through mud, rain and old barbed wire.
Avanzá con tu Renault FT junto a la infa: Advance in your Renault FT alongside the infantry and take the wood, Essey and Pannes. The German guns are withdrawing: don't let them get away.
El FT tiene torre de 360°: es el primer: The FT has a 360° turret: it's the first "modern" tank. But it's small: only two crew. If one falls, the tank is out of action.
16 de abril de 1917: el primer ataque de: April 16, 1917: the first French tank attack. Open chalk plain facing the Chemin des Dames heights, the road to Juvincourt and the German artillery watching from above.
Podés reintentarla las veces que quieras: You can retry it as many times as you like.
Las batallas reales, en orden. Cada misi: The real battles, in order. Each mission unlocks when you've completed the previous one and bought its tank. Winning it for the first time gives an extra RP and {} reward.

Las tropas de Franco avanzan sobre Madri: Franco's troops advance on Madrid. The Republic receives its first Soviet tanks: T-26s with volunteer crews under Captain Paul Arman. They attack without infantry support and drive alone into the village of Seseña.
Entrá a Seseña con tus T-26, limpiá el o: Drive into Seseña with your T-26s, clear the olive grove and the farmhouse. The Panzer Is only have machine guns: your 45 mm penetrates them from afar. Watch out for the anti-tank gun.
El T-26 tiene torre de 360° y un cañón e: The T-26 has a 360° turret and an excellent gun for its time. Its 15 mm armor can't withstand an anti-tank gun: don't stay still in the open.
Los nacionales cruzan el río Jarama para: The Nationalists cross the Jarama River to cut the Madrid–Valencia road. The International Brigades stop them on the ridges and both sides' tanks fight over Pingarrón hill.
Tomá los olivares, el cerro del Pingarró: Take the olive groves, Pingarrón hill and San Martín de la Vega. From the hill you can see everything: whoever holds it, rules.
Usá las lomas: asomá solo la torre para: Use the ridges: show only your turret to fire and pull back to reload. The trenches in this war are narrow: tanks cross them easily.
La misma batalla, del otro lado. Los Pan: The same battle, from the other side. The Condor Legion's Panzer Is and the Spanish tankers know their machine guns can't penetrate the T-26s: they depend on the 37 mm anti-tank guns and on attacking from the flanks.
Sostené las tres posiciones con tus Panz: Hold the three positions with your Panzers. Lure the T-26s toward your anti-tank guns and hit them in the sides and rear.
La munición perforante de la MG 13 apena: The MG 13's AP ammo barely gets through the T-26's 15 mm at very close range and from the side. Better: mark them for your Pak 36s and the artillery.
Ofensiva de Aragón. El Regimiento Intern: The Aragon offensive. The International Tank Regiment attacks with 48 newly arrived BT-5s, infantry riding on top, at full speed. No one warned them about the irrigation ditches or the anti-tank guns by the sugar mill.
Cruzá los campos de riego, tomá las chop: Cross the irrigated fields and take the poplar groves, the sugar mill and the town. The ditches slow you down: find the crossings and don't get stuck in front of the guns.
El BT-5 es el tanque más rápido del jueg: The BT-5 is the fastest tank in the game: use the speed to flank. Its 13 mm armor stops nothing.
El Afrika Korps está a 100 km de Alejand: The Afrika Korps is 100 km from Alexandria, short of fuel and without reinforcements. Rommel tries to outflank the British line from the south and climb Alam Halfa ridge. Montgomery waits for him with dug-in tanks and 6-pounder guns.
Tomá la loma del oeste (A) y sostenela u: Take the west ridge (A) and hold it for a minute and a half. The British fire from dug-in positions: look for them with binoculars before you show yourself.
El Panzer III J tiene munición subcalibr: The Panzer III J has sub-caliber ammo (key 2): it penetrates much more up close. Save it for the Matilda, which withstands almost everything from the front.
Después de diez días de combate, Montgom: After ten days of fighting, Montgomery launches the final push: the 9th Armoured Brigade charges at dawn against the anti-tank screen at Tel el Aqqaqir. If they break it, the Afrika Korps withdraws from Egypt.
Tomá Tel el Aqqaqir (C) y sostenelo un m: Take Tel el Aqqaqir (C) and hold it for a minute and a half. The Paks and the Panzer IV "Specials" wait for you behind the ridge.
En el desierto se ve todo a mucha distan: In the desert you can see everything from far away: use the ridges to hide your hull and show only the turret. The Crusader's 6-pounder penetrates the Panzer III from the front.
La ofensiva alemana más grande del veran: The biggest German offensive of the summer: break the Kursk salient from the south with Tigers and the first Panthers. The Soviets knew everything: for three months they dug anti-tank ditches, laid mines and built lines of guns.
Tomá el sovjós Oktiabrski (B) en la loma: Take the Oktyabrsky state farm (B) on the ridge and hold it for two minutes. The anti-tank ditches have crossings: find them before the guns find you.
El Tiger perfora al T-34 a más de un kil: The Tiger penetrates the T-34 beyond a kilometer: don't close in, let them come. If you fall into a ditch, you may not get out.
Kursk. El 5.º Ejército de Tanques de la: Kursk. The 5th Guards Tank Army counterattacks the II SS Panzer Corps. The Soviet tankers know the Tiger destroys them at a kilometer: the order is to charge at full speed and fight up close.
Destruí a los Tiger. Acortá la distancia: Destroy the Tigers. Close the distance fast, go for their sides and use the anti-tank ditches and ravines to get near unseen.
El 76 mm del T-34 no perfora al Tiger de: The T-34's 76 mm doesn't penetrate the Tiger from the front: from the side at under 300 m, it does. The T-34 is fast and its wide tracks don't get stuck.
Una semana después del Día D, la 7.ª Div: A week after D-Day, the 7th Armoured Division (the "Desert Rats") finds a gap in the front and enters Villers-Bocage. On Hill 213, a handful of Tigers from the 101st SS battalion are watching them.
Tomá Villers-Bocage (B) y sostenelo un m: Take Villers-Bocage (B) and hold it for a minute and a half. You can't see anything in the bocage: advance hedge by hedge and let the Firefly deal with the Tigers.
Los setos tapan la vista y los bordos de: The hedges block the view and the earth banks slow you down: look for the gates. The Cromwell is the fastest: flank instead of fighting head-on.
La misma mañana, del otro lado. Michael: The same morning, from the other side. From Hill 213 Michael Wittmann sees the British column halted on the road. Without waiting for reinforcements, he goes down alone in his Tiger, drives along the column and into the town, destroying everything in his path.
Hacé lo que hizo Wittmann: entrá a Ville: Do what Wittmann did: get into Villers-Bocage (B), destroy 4 enemies and return to your base with your tank intact.
De frente casi nada te perfora, pero el: From the front almost nothing penetrates you, but the Firefly does. The Cromwells are fast: don't show them your side or rear. In the town, watch out for anti-tank guns.
La última gran ofensiva alemana en el oe: The last great German offensive in the west. With fog and snow grounding the Allied aircraft, the Panzer divisions cross the Ardennes to reach Antwerp. Bastogne, a junction of seven roads, is in the way.
Tomá Bastogne (B) y sostenelo dos minuto: Take Bastogne (B) and hold it for two minutes. The Americans are surrounded but won't surrender: every wood may have an M10 waiting.
El Panther es casi imposible de perforar: The Panther is almost impossible to penetrate from the front: always show your glacis. In fog, shots come from close range: don't stand still on the roads.
La 101.ª Aerotransportada lleva una sema: The 101st Airborne has been surrounded in Bastogne for a week. "Nuts!" General McAuliffe replied to the demand for surrender. The Panthers attack along the snowy roads while Patton's Shermans fight their way in from the south.
Bastogne es tuyo: sostenelo 9 minutos. S: Bastogne is yours: hold it for 9 minutes. If the Germans retake the town, the mission fails.
El Panther es casi imposible de perforar: The Panther is almost impossible to penetrate from the front: wait for it in the woods and shoot its side. The M10 has an open turret: watch out for artillery.
